chapter: Germany, Paris and return to America
title: Returning to La Cigalle and settling into Europe
summary: A new offer from the Cigalle pulled him back to Paris instead of the States; he negotiated one day off a month for concerts, which helped establish his name.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: PS: When you came out of Germany you didn't go back to the States, you went back to Paris. Well, how -
No, I went back to the Cigalle again.
Yeah, that's what I just said.
When you came out of Germany you didn't go back to the States, you went back to Paris -
Well, the guy asked me to go back to Cigalle again, that's they way I -
thwarted your plan to come back.
And at that point would you say you knew you were pretty much gonna just stick around in Europe or did -

Oh, yeah, yeah, I kinda had it, mentally I felt that I was kinda gettin' up so people were dancing. Then when I went back the other time after that, I made an agreement with the guy to have a one day off a month, then I could do concerts. And then he stayed, I had a concert. 'Cause I'd write guys and tell 'em "I'm off every Wednesday once a month". And I'd get things, and that helped me to establish.
